applicationApproved.hidden: Your profile stays out of search and off its address until payouts are set up.
applicationApproved.intro: Good news: Zamaro approved your application, and you are now an artist on Zamaro.
applicationApproved.payouts: The next step is to set up payouts, so churches can book and pay you.
applicationApproved.subject: You’re approved on Zamaro
applicationReceived.intro: Your application {number} is in. We review every one by hand and reply by {replyBy}, 3 business days from now.
applicationReceived.next: First we call both of your references, then we read your application and watch your videos. Nothing is public until you’re approved.
applicationReceived.questions: Questions? Reply to this email or write to hello@zamaro.ca and quote application {number}.
applicationReceived.subject: We received your application, {number}
applicationRejected.again: You’re welcome to apply again once you’ve addressed this. Reply to this email or write to hello@zamaro.ca if you have questions.
applicationRejected.intro: Thank you for applying to Zamaro. We reviewed application {number} and we’re not able to approve it.
applicationRejected.subject: About your Zamaro application, {number}
confirmEmail.expiry: The link works for 24 hours, and only once.
confirmEmail.ignore: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email; nothing changes.
confirmEmail.intro: Open this link to sign in to Zamaro with this address from now on.
confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for Zamaro
duplicate.forgot: If you’ve forgotten your password, you can choose a new one.
duplicate.ignore: If it wasn’t you, there’s nothing to do: your account and password are as they were.
duplicate.intro: Someone tried to create a Zamaro account with {email} on {date}. You already have one, so nothing changed.
duplicate.signIn: If that was you, sign in instead.
duplicate.subject: Someone tried to sign up with your email
emailChanging.intro: Someone asked to sign in to your Zamaro account with {email} instead of this address.
emailChanging.notYou: If it wasn’t you, reset your password now: whoever asked knows it.
emailChanging.stays: Nothing changes until the link we sent to the new address is opened. Until then you sign in with {email}.
emailChanging.subject: Your Zamaro email is changing
footer: Zamaro · Worship artists for churches around Toronto · hello@zamaro.ca
locked.intro: There were 5 tries to sign in to Zamaro as {email} that didn’t work, so sign-in is paused until {time}.
locked.notYou: If it wasn’t you, reset your password now. Nobody got in.
locked.subject: Sign-in to your Zamaro account is paused
locked.wasYou: If it was you, wait until then, or choose a new password.
passwordChanged.intro: The password for {email} was changed on {date} at {time}, and every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If it wasn’t you, reset your password now and email hello@zamaro.ca.
passwordChanged.subject: Your Zamaro password was changed
reset.expiry: The link works for 60 minutes, and only once.
reset.ignore: If you didn’t ask, ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
reset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for {email} on Zamaro.
reset.subject: Reset your Zamaro password
twoStep.codes.intro: New recovery codes were made for {email}. The earlier ones no longer work.
twoStep.codes.subject: New recovery codes for your Zamaro account
twoStep.notYou: If it wasn’t you, reset your password now and email hello@zamaro.ca.
twoStep.off.intro: Two-step sign-in is now off for {email}. Zamaro asks only for your password when you sign in.
twoStep.off.subject: Two-step sign-in is off for your Zamaro account
twoStep.on.intro: Two-step sign-in is now on for {email}. From now on Zamaro asks for a code from your authenticator app after your password.
twoStep.on.subject: Two-step sign-in is on for your Zamaro account
verify.expiry: The link works for 24 hours, and only once.
verify.ignore: If you didn’t sign up for Zamaro, ignore this email and nothing will happen.
verify.intro: Confirm this is your address to finish signing up. Until you do, you can browse and save artists, but you can’t send a booking request.
verify.subject: Verify your email for Zamaro
vscRenewal.after: Upload the new check from the check section of your profile editor and we’ll verify it. A verified check counts for 3 years from its issue date.
vscRenewal.intro: Your verified Vulnerable Sector Check counts for Youth event searches until {date}. After that, churches planning a youth event will no longer see you.
vscRenewal.subject: Renew your Vulnerable Sector Check by {date}
